messages:
kevin: heads-up — onboarding orion-mini:int4 shows strange token-split + spacing on mixed CJK+RTL samples (ja/zh with embedded arabic identifiers). small repro attached.

yuki: can you paste a minimal failing example? that helps narrow whether it's tokenizer or quant path.

kevin: minimal: "受注番号（رقم الطلب：１２３４）を確認しました。"
- fp16 decode: "Order number (رقm al-talab: 1234) was confirmed."
- int4 decode: "Order number ( ر ق م  ال  ط ل ب : 1 2 3 4 ) was confirmed." (spaces between arabic graphemes and digits)

natalie: ouch. looks like subtoken merge/splitting for RTL clusters is failing in int4 build. did we change packing/kernels recently?

kevin: matmul_pack v1->v2 rolled yesterday on canary, and quant compiler updated qsplit heuristic on the same day. Timeline aligns.

kevin: repro command (staging):
```
python eval.py --model orion-mini:int4 --dataset multilingual-smoke --split ja-rtl-50 --detok detok_i18n.py --save /tmp/orion_int4_dump.txt
```

kevin: quick local diff from dump: token_id sequences around the Arabic cluster
- fp16_ids: [9001, 214, 6789]
- int4_ids: [9001, 32, 33, 34, 6789]
(32/33/34 are small-piece tokens we don't expect for Arabic cluster)

eval-bot: automated snapshot:
- model: orion-mini:int4
- dataset: multilingual-smoke/ja-rtl-50
- metric: BLEU
- fp16 baseline: 29.2
- int4 current: 23.6
- int4 + --no-subtoken-split: 28.7

yuki: that metric delta + the fact --no-subtoken-split helps points at runtime granularity/splitting during embedding lookup. could be packer alignment or tokenizer postprocess mismatch.

natalie: can you try int4 with an older packer build (packer_v1) and with --no-kvcache? if no-kvcache helps, KV cache scatter aggregation could be introducing small token boundaries on buffered prefixes.

kevin: running both now. quick result: int4+packer_v1 -> BLEU 27.9; int4+no-kvcache -> BLEU 26.8; int4+packer_v1+no-kvcache -> BLEU 28.1. so packer_v2 is main regression, kvcache amplifies.

yuki: thanks. plan: (1) natalie file INF-ML ticket to block packer_v2 on stable until fix, (2) infra to add token-roundtrip unit for mixed-script bidi clusters across quant profiles, (3) add this sample to regression set.

natalie: creating ticket INF-ML-4001 and adding regression prompt multilingual-smoke/regress/ja_ar_bracket_001.txt. also pinging build owners for packer_v2 hold.

ops-bot: noted. I can pin canary to packer_v1 for next 2 hours if you want to expedite testing. :wrench:

kevin: please do pin canary packer_v1 for a repro window. we'll iterate on a minimal fix to canonicalize clusters before packer step. cc @yuki.

yuki: I'll start a small PR that forces cluster canonicalization and add the unit test. if that doesn't succeed, we'll fallback to disabling subtoken_split in int4 builds as a short-term mitigation.

natalie: thanks team. keeping thread open — will update when ticket and PR are live. :thumbsup:
